## 桌面控制默认开启与工具卡片精简

### 桌面控制默认开启

- 「设置 → Extensions → 桌面控制」新增「新会话默认开启」。这是服务全局设置，此前为关闭，**现在默认开启**：之后新建的对话自动获得桌面控制授权，无需逐个开启。只在本机回环地址生效。
- 单条对话仍可随时关闭；关闭会立即中止执行中的桌面工具。已手动切换过的会话不会被全局默认值覆盖。
- 修复扩展清单早于扩展工厂登记默认值读取授权、导致默认值不生效的问题。
- 清单新增「未检测到桌面辅助程序」提示，需先运行 `pi-harness install-desktop-control`，否则开启后仍无法操作窗口。

> 安全提示：默认开启意味着新会话可直接读取本机窗口截图、模拟点击、输入文字和滚动。窗口截图会发送给当前会话的模型，输入操作会使用本机鼠标键盘。仍受回环地址限制与「先查看窗口、再按快照操作」约束。可在同一设置页关闭全局默认，或逐会话关闭。

### 工具卡片精简

- 读取行右侧的「放大查看」「复制」改为紧凑图标按钮，动作由 title 与无障碍标签说明，不再把文字挤进状态行。
- Edit/Write 卡片的行内 diff 去掉与卡片标题重复的文件行与容器样式，只保留改动内容。

## Desktop control on by default, tighter tool cards

### Desktop control on by default

- New service-wide switch "On by default for new chats" under Settings → Extensions → Desktop control. It was off; **it now defaults to on**, so conversations started afterwards get desktop control without opting in each time. Loopback hosts only.
- A single conversation can still turn it off, which cancels running desktop tools. A conversation you already switched manually is never overridden by the service default.
- Fix the extension inventory reading the grant before the extension factory records the default, which made the default ineffective.
- Flag a missing desktop helper: run `pi-harness install-desktop-control` first, otherwise window actions still fail.

> Security: defaulting to on lets new conversations read window screenshots, click, type and scroll. Screenshots are sent to the current conversation's model, and input uses the local mouse and keyboard. It stays bound to loopback and to the view-then-act snapshot rule. Turn the service default off here, or revoke it per conversation.

### Tighter tool cards

- Turn "Zoom" and "Copy" on the read row into compact icon buttons labelled through title and accessibility attributes instead of squeezing text into the status row.
- Drop the duplicate file row and container chrome from inline Edit/Write diffs, keeping the changed lines.
